verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no built-in natural-language command interface in Gitea. Its UI, API, webhooks, and the tea CLI are all structured interfaces. The official MCP server (gitea-probe-3) lets external AI agents call Gitea tools, but that is evidence for the separate MCP-server story. The natural-language interpretation would come from a third-party agent, so it is adjacent support and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
